rows.label: tlk70000001_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Makumaku's information network and
mobility are unbelievable, mo. It's a
nightmare grown arms and legs, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000001_05_msg0002
rows.name:
I feel eyes on me wherever I go, mo!
Even when I try to shake Macmac, I'm
headed off, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Morumo was in trouble, mo. Really,
really troubled... so I started
spending more time with everyone, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_05_msg0004
rows.name:
I worry about Makumaku when I'm
alone, mo. With everyone, I forget all
about Makumaku, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_05_msg0005
rows.name:
Then everyone started telling me more
things than before, mo. They helped
Morumo too, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_05_msg0006
rows.name:
Morumo... started wanting to work even
harder, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000001_05_msg0007
rows.name:
I can't lose to Makumaku, mo. I'll get
results and make the shopping district
even bigger, mo!!
